statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope accompanied by palpitations
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
CPT code 93226 (48-hour Holter monitor) was billed
The diagnoses R55 and I47.1 are on the claim
The denial reason code is PR-204
A 48-hour Holter monitor is medically necessary to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity and guide further management
